beats.vo: You have an idea. But is it actually investable?
Most founders just guess. They pitch friends, and mistake politeness for proof.
Trinity reads your idea the way real investors actually think. Three lenses.
Desirability. Does anyone truly want it?
Feasibility. Can you actually build it?
Viability. Will it fund itself, and last?
Each lens scored blind, across sixty dimensions. No single story inflates the rest.
Then they cross-link, and converge into one honest verdict.
Your stage, and the exact investors to talk to next, across the US and Taiwan.
Feed your idea to the engine. Your first read is free.
Trinity. From an idea, to an investable startup.
